selector_info.selection_contract: Target-wise pair blend configs are selected from a full-OOF diagnostic report, then applied to the matching OOF/test artifacts.
selector_info.caution: High-risk OOF-selected artifact recombination probe. This is not strict Subject-Hole CV, not nested, and not public proof.
